Eberouge.name: Eberouge
Eberouge.summary:
Eberouge is a love simulation game created by Fujitsu on home computers and later ported to Sega Saturn and Sony PlayStation.
The story happens in a fantasy land named EbeLand. Long ago, this land was saved by the Goddess Ebe from total destruction, but years later, an archeologist felt the balance of the land tipping again. So he created institutes to train students that can create magic to save the land once more.
